creators.name: Marshmallow Laser Feast
creators.bio: London collective founded in 2011 by Memo Akten, Robin McNicholas and Barnaby Steel, now led by McNicholas, Steel and Ersin Han Ersin. It makes research-led multisensory installations, VR and video works about breath, trees, animals and the systems that connect them, often built from LiDAR scans, medical imaging and scientific datasets.
creators.bio_zh: 2011 年由 Memo Akten、Robin McNicholas 与 Barnaby Steel 在伦敦创立，现由 McNicholas、Steel 与 Ersin Han Ersin 主导。团体以研究为基础，创作关于呼吸、树木、动物及其相互联系的多感官装置、VR 与影像作品，常用 LiDAR 扫描、医学影像与科学数据构建画面。
creators.why: In the Eyes of the Animal (2015) and Treehugger (2016) are among the first VR works to let audiences perceive a forest as a mosquito, an owl or a 3,000-year-old sequoia, and their later work keeps returning to the umwelt of other beings.
creators.why_zh: 《In the Eyes of the Animal》（2015）与《Treehugger》（2016）是最早让观众以蚊子、猫头鹰或一棵三千岁红杉的方式感知森林的 VR 作品之一，此后的创作也不断回到其他生命的环境界。

creators.name: Robin McNicholas
creators.role: Co-founder and director, Marshmallow Laser Feast
creators.role_zh: Marshmallow Laser Feast 联合创始人、导演
creators.bio: Artist and director (b. 1979) who co-founded Marshmallow Laser Feast in 2011 and directed Treehugger: Wawona, In the Eyes of the Animal and Evolver.
creators.bio_zh: 艺术家、导演（生于 1979 年），2011 年联合创立 Marshmallow Laser Feast，执导了《Treehugger: Wawona》《In the Eyes of the Animal》与《Evolver》等作品。
creators.why: Directed several of the best-known VR works that put audiences inside animal senses and tree time.
creators.why_zh: 执导了多部让观众进入动物感官与“树的时间”的代表性 VR 作品。

creators.name: Barnaby Steel
creators.role: Co-founder and director, Marshmallow Laser Feast
creators.role_zh: Marshmallow Laser Feast 联合创始人、导演
creators.bio: Artist and director (b. 1978), co-founder of Marshmallow Laser Feast, who leads much of the collective's writing on breath, reciprocity and the atmosphere as 'a co-creation of all breathing beings'.
creators.bio_zh: 艺术家、导演（生于 1978 年），Marshmallow Laser Feast 联合创始人，主导团体关于呼吸、互惠与“大气是所有呼吸生命共同创造之物”的写作与构思。
creators.why: Frames MLF's works as ways to feel human breath as part of a planetary exchange with trees, fungi and microbes.
creators.why_zh: 把 MLF 的作品构想为一种途径，让人感受到自己的呼吸是与树木、真菌和微生物共同参与的行星交换的一部分。

creators.name: Ersin Han Ersin
creators.role: Director and partner, Marshmallow Laser Feast
creators.role_zh: Marshmallow Laser Feast 导演、合伙人
creators.bio: Artist and director (b. 1984) from Istanbul who joined Marshmallow Laser Feast and co-leads its research-based installations such as Seeing Echoes in the Mind of the Whale and Of the Oak.
creators.bio_zh: 来自伊斯坦布尔的艺术家、导演（生于 1984 年），加入 Marshmallow Laser Feast 后共同主导《Seeing Echoes in the Mind of the Whale》《Of the Oak》等以研究为基础的装置。
creators.why: Drives MLF's recent work on cetacean hearing, soil life and oak ecosystems with scientific partners.
creators.why_zh: 与科研伙伴合作，推动 MLF 近年关于鲸类听觉、土壤生命与橡树生态的创作。

creators.name: Memo Akten
creators.role: Artist and researcher; early co-founder of Marshmallow Laser Feast
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、研究者；Marshmallow Laser Feast 早期联合创始人
creators.bio: Turkish-born artist working with code, data and machine learning. He co-founded Marshmallow Laser Feast in 2011 and left in 2014 to do a PhD in AI at Goldsmiths.
creators.bio_zh: 出生于土耳其的艺术家，以代码、数据与机器学习创作。2011 年联合创立 Marshmallow Laser Feast，2014 年离开并前往 Goldsmiths 攻读人工智能博士。
creators.why: His later work on how neural networks 'see' (e.g. Learning to See) is a key reference for machine perception as another umwelt.
creators.why_zh: 他后来关于神经网络如何“看见”的作品（如《Learning to See》）是把机器感知视为另一种环境界的重要参照。

creators.name: Abandon Normal Devices
creators.role: Arts commissioning agency and festival, north-west England
creators.role_zh: 英格兰西北部的艺术委约机构与艺术节
creators.bio: Arts organisation that commissions work at the edge of art, technology and landscape, and runs the AND Festival in rural sites such as Grizedale Forest and Castleton.
creators.bio_zh: 委约艺术、技术与自然景观交叉作品的艺术机构，在格里兹代尔森林、卡斯尔顿等乡野场地举办 AND 艺术节。
creators.why: Commissioned and co-produced In the Eyes of the Animal with Forestry Commission England, one of the founding works of animal-umwelt VR.
creators.why_zh: 与英格兰林业委员会共同委约并联合制作《In the Eyes of the Animal》，这是动物环境界 VR 的奠基之作之一。

creators.name: Atlas V
creators.bio: French studio producing VR and immersive works for festivals and museums, including Spheres, Gloomy Eyes, Battlescar and Marshmallow Laser Feast's Evolver.
creators.bio_zh: 法国沉浸式内容制作公司，为电影节与博物馆制作 VR 与沉浸式作品，包括《Spheres》《Gloomy Eyes》《Battlescar》以及 Marshmallow Laser Feast 的《Evolver》。
creators.why: Co-produced Evolver and several cosmic- and body-scale VR works that shift the viewer's sense of scale.
creators.why_zh: 联合制作了《Evolver》以及多部改变观众尺度感的宇宙尺度与身体尺度 VR 作品。

creators.name: Tom Mustill
creators.bio: Wildlife filmmaker and author of How to Speak Whale (2022), who works with scientists using machine learning to study animal communication.
creators.bio_zh: 野生动物电影人，著有《How to Speak Whale》（2022），与用机器学习研究动物交流的科学家合作。
creators.why: Guided the research behind Seeing Echoes in the Mind of the Whale, MLF's work on cetacean echolocation and song.
creators.why_zh: 为 MLF 关于鲸类回声定位与鲸歌的作品《Seeing Echoes in the Mind of the Whale》提供研究指导。

creators.name: Natan Sinigaglia
creators.role: Visual artist and real-time graphics designer
creators.role_zh: 视觉艺术家、实时图形设计师
creators.bio: Italian visual artist working with generative and real-time graphics (vvvv), long-time collaborator of Marshmallow Laser Feast on Treehugger and Evolver.
creators.bio_zh: 意大利视觉艺术家，以生成式与实时图形（vvvv）创作，长期与 Marshmallow Laser Feast 合作《Treehugger》与《Evolver》。
creators.why: Built the particle-based visual language MLF uses to show water, oxygen and carbon flowing through trees and bodies.
creators.why_zh: 构建了 MLF 用来呈现水、氧气与碳在树木和身体中流动的粒子视觉语言。

creators.name: Polymorf
creators.role: Interdisciplinary artist collective for multisensory XR
creators.role_zh: 多感官 XR 跨学科艺术团体
creators.bio: Dutch collective led by Marcel van Brakel that builds multisensory VR installations with haptic suits, soft robotics, scent and food.
creators.bio_zh: 由 Marcel van Brakel 主导的荷兰团体，以触觉服、软体机器人、气味与食物打造多感官 VR 装置。
creators.why: Symbiosis lets visitors inhabit a slime mould, a toad or an orchid through haptics, smell and taste, a rare full-body take on becoming nonhuman.
creators.why_zh: 《Symbiosis》通过触觉、嗅觉与味觉让观众化身黏菌、蟾蜍或兰花，是少见的全身式“成为非人类”体验。

creators.name: Anagram
creators.role_zh: 沉浸式与互动叙事工作室
creators.bio: British studio founded by May Abdalla and Amy Rose that makes documentary-based immersive installations, VR and theatre.
creators.bio_zh: 由 May Abdalla 与 Amy Rose 创立的英国工作室，创作以纪录片为基础的沉浸式装置、VR 与剧场作品。
creators.why: Door Into the Dark removes sight entirely and asks visitors to navigate by touch and sound, a counterpoint to headset-based sensory worlds.
creators.why_zh: 《Door Into the Dark》完全拿走视觉，让观众靠触觉与声音前行，是对头显式感官世界的一种对照。

creators.name: DRIFT
creators.role: Art studio of Lonneke Gordijn and Ralph Nauta
creators.role_zh: Lonneke Gordijn 与 Ralph Nauta 的艺术工作室
creators.bio: Dutch studio founded in 2007 that builds kinetic sculptures and performances translating natural behaviour, such as starling murmurations and blooming flowers, into machines.
creators.bio_zh: 2007 年创立的荷兰工作室，把椋鸟群飞、花朵开合等自然行为转译为机械，创作动态雕塑与表演。
creators.why: Franchise Freedom lets hundreds of drones fly by a starling-flocking algorithm, making machine bodies move as a flock.
creators.why_zh: 《Franchise Freedom》让数百架无人机按椋鸟群飞算法飞行，使机器身体像鸟群一样移动。

creators.name: onformative
creators.role: Studio for digital art and design
creators.role_zh: 数字艺术与设计工作室
creators.bio: Berlin studio founded by Cedric Kiefer and Julia Laub that makes generative, data-driven installations about nature and perception.
creators.bio_zh: 由 Cedric Kiefer 与 Julia Laub 创立的柏林工作室，创作关于自然与感知的生成式、数据驱动装置。
creators.why: Meandering River compresses the slow movement of rivers into perceivable time, a model for making geological rhythms felt.
creators.why_zh: 《Meandering River》把河流缓慢的变迁压缩到人可以感知的时间里，是让地质节奏被感受到的一种范例。

works.title: In the Eyes of the Animal
works.description: A VR journey through Grizedale Forest along the food chain, seen successively through the senses of a mosquito, a dragonfly, a frog and an owl. Visitors wear a headset inside a sculptural helmet and a vibrating backpack while a binaural forest soundscape plays.
works.description_zh: 一段沿食物链穿越格里兹代尔森林的 VR 旅程，依次以蚊子、蜻蜓、青蛙与猫头鹰的感官观看森林。观众戴着装在雕塑式头盔里的头显、背着振动背包，聆听双耳森林声景。
works.idea_en: Each animal is a different forest: the mosquito sees plumes of carbon dioxide, the dragonfly sees at 240 frames per second, the owl sees only what it faces.
works.idea_zh: 每种动物都是一片不同的森林：蚊子看见二氧化碳的烟流，蜻蜓以每秒 240 帧观看，猫头鹰只看见正对着的东西。
works.method: LiDAR scans, CT scans, photogrammetry and 360° drone footage of Grizedale Forest rendered in real time in vvvv, with a MaxMSP binaural engine, a SubPac haptic backpack for wingbeats and croaks, and scent; later released as a 360° film.
works.method_zh: 对格里兹代尔森林进行 LiDAR 扫描、CT 扫描、摄影测量与 360° 无人机拍摄，在 vvvv 中实时渲染；MaxMSP 双耳音频引擎、SubPac 振动背包模拟翅膀振动与蛙鸣，并配合气味；之后发行为 360° 影片。
shown_at: Supersenses, National Science and Media Museum, Bradford 2017
Particles of Existence, Phi Centre, Montreal 2018

works.title: Treehugger: Wawona
works.description: A mixed-reality installation built around a large tactile sculpture of a giant sequoia: visitors hug the trunk, put their head into a knot wearing a headset, and follow water rising from roots to canopy. The longer they hug, the deeper they drift into accelerated 'tree time'.
works.description_zh: 一件围绕巨型红杉触感雕塑展开的混合现实装置：观众拥抱树干，戴着头显把头伸进树瘤，跟随水从根部升到树冠。抱得越久，就越深地进入被加速的“树的时间”。
works.idea_en: Becoming a 3,000-year-old tree means slowing down to its time and feeling its sap move, and the hug is the interface.
works.idea_zh: 成为一棵三千岁的树，就是放慢到它的时间、感受树液的流动，而拥抱就是交互方式。
works.method: LiDAR and white-light scans of the Wawona sequoia in Sequoia National Park, made with the Natural History Museum and University of Salford, drive a real-time particle simulation of water and CO2 flow; a tactile sculpture, scent, haptics and a binaural soundscape of biosignals by Mileece I'Anson complete it.
works.method_zh: 与伦敦自然历史博物馆和索尔福德大学合作，对红杉国家公园中的 Wawona 红杉进行 LiDAR 与白光扫描，驱动水与二氧化碳流动的实时粒子模拟；触感雕塑、气味、触觉反馈，以及 Mileece I'Anson 由生物信号生成的双耳声景共同构成体验。
shown_at: VR Arles Festival Best VR Film 2018
Breathing with Trees, Tai Kwun, Hong Kong 2022

works.title: We Live in an Ocean of Air
works.description: A multi-user VR installation in which visitors stand beneath a giant sequoia and see their own exhaled breath as particles that flow into the tree, while its oxygen flows back into them. Later editions present it as a large video installation.
works.description_zh: 一件多人 VR 装置：观众站在巨型红杉下，看见自己呼出的气息化作粒子流入树中，而树释放的氧气又流回身体。后续版本以大型影像装置形式展出。
works.idea_en: Breath is shared with trees: each exhale feeds the sequoia and each inhale comes from it, so the boundary between body and plant becomes a loop.
works.idea_zh: 呼吸与树共享：每一次呼气都在喂养红杉，每一次吸气都来自它，身体与植物的边界变成一个循环。
works.method: Untethered VR with backpack PCs, hand tracking, breath sensors and heart-rate monitors that turn each visitor's breathing and pulse into real-time particles; binaural sound, scent diffusion and wind machines; sequoia data from the Treehugger LiDAR scans.
works.method_zh: 背包电脑驱动的无线 VR，配有手部追踪、呼吸传感器与心率监测，把每位观众的呼吸与脉搏实时转化为粒子；配合双耳声音、气味扩散与风机；红杉数据来自《Treehugger》的 LiDAR 扫描。
shown_at: Plásmata: Bodies, Dreams, and Data, Onassis Foundation, Athens 2022
Breathe | Mauri Ora, Te Papa, Wellington 2025–26

works.title: Sweet Dreams
works.description: First a VR dining experience in which visitors ate and drank real food while a virtual feast responded (Sundance 2019), then a 60-minute walk-through show at Factory International (2024) following Chicky Ricky, the chicken mascot of a failing fast-food company, through the food chain.
works.description_zh: 最初是一场 VR 用餐体验：观众吃喝真实的食物，虚拟盛宴随之回应（2019 年圣丹斯）；2024 年在 Factory International 发展为 60 分钟的步行式演出，跟随一家没落快餐公司的吉祥物“小鸡 Ricky”穿越食物链。
works.idea_en: A mostly human-centred satire: the chicken appears only as a cartoon mascot, which is the point about how food culture hides the animal on the plate.
works.idea_zh: 一部以人类为中心的讽刺作品：鸡只以卡通吉祥物的形象出现，而这正是它要说的：食物文化如何把盘中的动物藏起来。
works.method: 2019: tracked cutlery, food and drink with sensing of eating and drinking inside a theatrical VR set with live actors; 2024: real-time graphics, a custom VR puppeteering pipeline, motion capture, sculpture and spatial audio across eight rooms.
works.method_zh: 2019 年版：在有真人演员的剧场式 VR 场景中追踪餐具、食物与饮品，并感知吃喝动作；2024 年版：八个房间里结合实时图形、定制的 VR 木偶操控流程、动作捕捉、雕塑与空间音频。

works.title: Evolver
works.description: A collective VR journey that follows a breath of oxygen from the exhale of a tree into the lungs, through the branching blood vessels and down to a single breathing cell, narrated by Cate Blanchett. It was later expanded into screen installations and a lie-down overhead projection, The Breathing Cell.
works.description_zh: 一段集体 VR 旅程：跟随一口氧气，从树的呼气进入肺部，穿过分叉的血管，最终抵达一个正在“呼吸”的细胞，由 Cate Blanchett 旁白。之后扩展为银幕装置与躺卧观看的穹顶投影《The Breathing Cell》。
works.idea_en: The body is presented as a forest of branching vessels, so following oxygen inward ends up connecting the viewer outward to trees.
works.idea_zh: 身体被呈现为由分叉血管组成的森林，于是跟随氧气向内走，最终把观众向外连接到树。
works.method: Multi-user VR built from MRI and CT medical imaging processed with Fraunhofer MEVIS and cell models from the Allen Institute for Cell Science, with particles pulsing at a resonant breathing rhythm; music by Jonny Greenwood, Meredith Monk and Jon Hopkins; executive produced by Terrence Malick and Edward R. Pressman.
works.method_zh: 多人 VR，画面基于与 Fraunhofer MEVIS 合作处理的 MRI、CT 医学影像以及艾伦细胞科学研究所的细胞模型，粒子随共振呼吸节奏脉动；音乐来自 Jonny Greenwood、Meredith Monk 与 Jon Hopkins；Terrence Malick 与 Edward R. Pressman 担任监制。
shown_at: Teatr Wielki – Polish National Opera, Warsaw 2023
Adventures in Consciousness, University of Oxford 2024
Flesh and Bones, ArtScience Museum, Singapore 2026

works.title: Of the Oak
works.description: A 12-minute interactive video installation that follows Kew's Lucombe oak through four seasons, revealing the fungi, insects, birds and lichens it hosts, with multichannel sound, open-eyed breathing meditations and an online field guide to oak-associated species.
works.description_zh: 一件 12 分钟的互动影像装置，跟随邱园的 Lucombe 橡树经历四季，揭示它所承载的真菌、昆虫、鸟类与地衣；配有多声道声音、睁眼呼吸冥想，以及介绍橡树相关物种的在线图鉴。
works.idea_en: An oak is presented as a web of more than 2,300 species rather than a single tree, and breath is the audience's way in.
works.idea_zh: 橡树被呈现为一张由两千三百多个物种组成的网，而不是一棵孤立的树，呼吸是观众进入其中的方式。
works.method: Photogrammetry and LiDAR of the Lucombe oak, CT scans of soil samples, ground-penetrating radar of the roots and 24-hour sound recordings made with Kew's Tree Gang, with species drawn from the OakEcol dataset; meditations written by Daisy Lafarge, Merlin Sheldrake, Ella Saltmarshe and Laline Paull.
works.method_zh: 对 Lucombe 橡树进行摄影测量与 LiDAR 扫描，对土壤样本做 CT 扫描，用探地雷达追踪根系，并在邱园树木团队协助下进行 24 小时录音；物种信息来自 OakEcol 数据集；冥想文本由 Daisy Lafarge、Merlin Sheldrake、Ella Saltmarshe 与 Laline Paull 撰写。
shown_at: Shapes of Becoming, Jing'an Sculpture Park, Shanghai 2026

works.title: Forest (Laser Forest)
works.description: A 450 m² interactive installation of more than 150 springy rods, each tuned to a note and tipped with a laser, which visitors tap, shake and pluck to set off swinging patterns of light and spatial sound.
works.description_zh: 一件占地 450 平方米的互动装置，由 150 多根带激光、各自调成一个音的弹性杆组成；观众敲、摇、拨动这些“树”，引发摆动的光影与空间声音。
works.idea_en: A playful, human-centred forest: trees become musical instruments that answer touch, an early MLF step toward forests as responsive environments.
works.idea_zh: 一片以人为中心、充满玩性的森林：树变成回应触摸的乐器，是 MLF 走向“会回应的森林”的早期一步。
works.method: Tuning-fork-like vibrating rods with sensors and lasers, each mapped to a tone and played through surround sound.
works.method_zh: 类似音叉的振动杆装有传感器与激光，每根对应一个音高，通过环绕声系统播放。

works.title: Meet Your Creator
works.description: A live 'robo-ballet' for the Saatchi & Saatchi New Directors' Showcase at Cannes Lions, in which a fleet of quadrotor drones carrying LEDs and motorised mirrors danced with moving-head spotlights to music by Oneohtrix Point Never.
works.description_zh: 为戛纳国际创意节 Saatchi & Saatchi 新导演展映创作的现场“机器人芭蕾”：一队装有 LED 与电动镜面的四旋翼无人机与摇头灯共舞，配乐来自 Oneohtrix Point Never。
works.idea_en: Drones, then known mainly as weapons, are recast as graceful performing bodies; the audience watches machine bodies rather than inhabiting them.
works.idea_zh: 当时主要被视为武器的无人机被重新塑造成优雅的表演身体；观众是在观看机器身体，而不是进入其中。
works.method: Custom quadrotors with LEDs and motorised mirrors, choreographed in a virtual animation system whose data drove the physical drones and automated spotlights in sync with the score.
works.method_zh: 定制四旋翼无人机装有 LED 与电动镜面；在虚拟动画系统中编舞，数据直接驱动实体无人机与自动聚光灯，并与配乐同步。
shown_at: Saatchi & Saatchi New Directors' Showcase, Cannes Lions 2012

works.title: A Colossal Wave
works.description: A multi-location mixed-reality public artwork about human impact in the Anthropocene, using four VR 'umbrellas', a drop tower, a bowling ball, a gong and a sound-reactive gallery installation in which a physical impact sets off a virtual wave.
works.description_zh: 一件关于人类世人类影响的多地点混合现实公共艺术：使用四把 VR “伞”、落塔、保龄球、锣与声音反应装置，一次真实的撞击会引发一道虚拟巨浪。
works.idea_en: Human action is made to ripple outward as a wave, a physical metaphor for impact rather than an embodiment of water.
works.idea_zh: 人的动作像波浪一样向外扩散，这是对“影响”的物理隐喻，而不是成为水本身。
works.method: Umbrella-mounted VR viewers, AR and a sound-reactive installation triggered by physical impacts, made with Presstube, Dpt. and Headspace Studio.
works.method_zh: 装在伞上的 VR 观看器、AR 与由物理撞击触发的声音反应装置，与 Presstube、Dpt. 及 Headspace Studio 合作完成。

works.title: Distortions in Spacetime
works.description: An interactive audiovisual installation in which visitors' movements are mirrored by particle systems as they fall toward a black hole and witness a supernova, tracing the elements in their bodies back to dying stars.
works.description_zh: 一件互动视听装置：观众的动作由粒子系统映照，仿佛坠向黑洞并目睹超新星爆发，把身体里的元素追溯到死去的恒星。
works.idea_en: The body is shown as star matter: stepping toward the event horizon links a human gesture to cosmic scale and deep time.
works.idea_zh: 身体被呈现为恒星物质：走向事件视界，把人的一个动作连接到宇宙尺度与深时间。
works.method: Body tracking drives real-time particle simulations of gravitational collapse, with music by Arthur Jeffes (Penguin Cafe) and scientific advice from astrophysicist Samaya Nissanke.
works.method_zh: 身体追踪驱动引力坍缩的实时粒子模拟，音乐由 Arthur Jeffes（Penguin Cafe）创作，天体物理学家 Samaya Nissanke 担任科学顾问。
shown_at: Manchester Science Festival, Science and Industry Museum 2018
Into the Black Hole, Valkhof Museum, Nijmegen 2023–24
The Presence of Absence, Frankfurter Kunstverein 2024

works.title: The Tides Within Us
works.description: A series of installations and six large prints that follow oxygen from the lungs through the branching vessels of the body, showing the body's interior as a tidal, tree-like ecosystem.
works.description_zh: 一组装置与六幅大尺寸版画，跟随氧气从肺部穿过身体分叉的血管，把身体内部呈现为潮汐般、树状的生态系统。
works.idea_en: A human-centred work about breath: the body is shown as open to its surroundings, with no clear line where air ends and blood begins.
works.idea_zh: 一件以人为中心、关于呼吸的作品：身体被呈现为向周围敞开的系统，空气在哪里结束、血液从哪里开始并无清晰界线。
works.method: Medical imaging of the lungs and vascular system rendered with CG artist Erik Ferguson, shown as projections and Giclée prints.
works.method_zh: 以肺与血管系统的医学影像为基础，与 CG 艺术家 Erik Ferguson 合作渲染，以投影与微喷版画呈现。
shown_at: The State of Us, The Lowry, Salford 2019–20
Human Nature, York Mediale, York Art Gallery 2020–21
Breathe | Mauri Ora, Te Papa, Wellington 2025–26

works.title: Dream
works.description: A live online performance inspired by A Midsummer Night's Dream, set in a virtual forest where Puck and the sprites Cobweb, Mustardseed, Peaseblossom and Moth are played live by motion-captured actors, and online audiences help regrow the forest before dawn.
works.description_zh: 一场取材于《仲夏夜之梦》的线上现场演出：在虚拟森林中，帕克与小精灵蛛网、芥子、豆花和飞蛾由动作捕捉演员实时演绎，线上观众帮助森林在黎明前重新生长。
works.idea_en: Mainly a theatre experiment; the forest and its sprites are the world the audience moves through, from canopy to roots.
works.idea_zh: 主要是一次剧场实验；森林与其中的精灵构成观众穿行的世界，从树冠一直到树根。
works.method: Live motion capture in Unreal Engine (with Epic Games), an interactive symphonic score by the Philharmonia Orchestra responding to the actors, and audience interaction via phone or browser; 10 performances reached 65,000 people.
works.method_zh: 基于 Unreal Engine（与 Epic Games 合作）的实时动作捕捉，爱乐管弦乐团的互动交响配乐随演员动作变化，观众通过手机或浏览器参与；10 场演出覆盖 6.5 万人。
shown_at: Royal Shakespeare Company / Manchester International Festival online 2021

works.title: Sanctuary of the Unseen Forest
works.description: A large-scale video installation built around a giant Ceiba pentandra (kapok) from the Colombian Amazon, peeling back its layers to show water, carbon and nutrients pulsing from crown to roots and into the mycorrhizal network, in time with the viewer's heartbeat.
works.description_zh: 一件围绕哥伦比亚亚马孙一棵巨型吉贝木棉（Ceiba pentandra）的大型影像装置，层层剥开树体，呈现水、碳与养分从树冠到根部、再进入菌根网络的脉动，节奏与观众心跳相呼应。
works.idea_en: A response to 'plant blindness': the tree's inner flows are made visible so that it reads as a living, breathing being.
works.idea_zh: 回应“植物盲”：让树内部的流动变得可见，使它被看作一个活着、呼吸着的生命。
works.method: LiDAR, photogrammetry, ecological surveys and ambisonic field recordings of a Ceiba pentandra near Leticia, Colombia (2020), rendered as single-channel 4K video with 10.1-channel audio.
works.method_zh: 2020 年在哥伦比亚莱蒂西亚附近对一棵吉贝木棉进行 LiDAR 扫描、摄影测量、生态调查与全景声野外录音，呈现为单屏 4K 影像与 10.1 声道音频。
shown_at: Our Time on Earth, Barbican, London 2022
Fungi – In Art and Science, Nobel Prize Museum, Stockholm 2023–24
Our Time on Earth, Musée de la civilisation, Québec 2023–24
Our Time on Earth, Peabody Essex Museum 2024

works.title: Breathing with the Forest
works.description: A three-channel video installation and open-eyed meditation set around a capinuri tree in the Colombian Amazon, in which visitors synchronise their breath with audiovisual cues as the flows of carbon, water, oxygen and nitrogen through the forest are revealed.
works.description_zh: 一件三屏影像装置兼睁眼冥想，场景是哥伦比亚亚马孙的一棵 capinuri 树；观众随视听提示同步呼吸，森林中碳、水、氧与氮的流动逐渐显现。
works.idea_en: Breathing in time with the forest extends the body into the ecosystem, so the forest reads as a larger lung the visitor is part of.
works.idea_zh: 与森林同步呼吸，把身体延伸进生态系统，森林就像一片更大的肺，而观众是其中一部分。
works.method: LiDAR scans, photogrammetry and ambisonic recordings of a capinuri tree (Maquira coriacea) made in 2020, rendered as a 4-minute 3-channel video on 4.8 m screens with 20.2-channel audio.
works.method_zh: 基于 2020 年对 capinuri 树（Maquira coriacea）的 LiDAR 扫描、摄影测量与全景声录音，呈现为 3 块 4.8 米宽屏幕上的 4 分钟三屏影像，配 20.2 声道音频。
shown_at: Shifting Landscapes, Emergence Magazine, Oxo Tower Wharf, London 2023

works.title: Forest Bathing: Lupuna
works.description: A permanent two-room installation in a German spa: visitors step through a waterfall into a simulated tropical downpour, then lie on heated lily-pad loungers beneath a 4.5 m projection that compresses 24 hours in the canopy of a Lupuna (kapok) tree into five minutes, including the night bloom of a Queen of the Night flower.
works.description_zh: 德国一处温泉中的永久性双室装置：观众穿过瀑布进入模拟的热带暴雨，再躺在加热的睡莲叶形躺椅上，仰望 4.5 米投影——吉贝木棉（Lupuna）树冠中的 24 小时被压缩为五分钟，包括夜昙花在夜间的绽放。
works.idea_en: Plant time is sped up to human attention: a day of epiphytes, lianas and a night-blooming flower pollinated by bats and moths unfolds in minutes.
works.idea_zh: 把植物的时间加速到人的注意力尺度：附生植物、藤蔓，以及由蝙蝠和飞蛾授粉的夜开花朵，一天的变化在几分钟内展开。
works.method: Rain machines, spatial audio and lighting in the first room; temperature-controlled loungers and a three-level magnification (tree, branch, flower) of footage and scans from Leticia, Colombia, in the second.
works.method_zh: 第一室使用人造雨装置、空间音频与灯光；第二室配有温控躺椅，以树、枝、花三级放大呈现来自哥伦比亚莱蒂西亚的影像与扫描。

works.title: Seeing Echoes in the Mind of the Whale
works.description: A large video installation in three chapters, each following a bottlenose dolphin, a humpback whale or a sperm whale as it breathes and dives; with each breath the view switches to how that species might 'see' its world through sound.
works.description_zh: 一件分为三章的大型影像装置，分别跟随宽吻海豚、座头鲸与抹香鲸呼吸和下潜；每一次换气，视角就切换为该物种可能如何通过声音“看见”世界。
works.idea_en: Sound becomes a sculpting tool: dolphin clicks shape images, humpback song carries memory, and sperm-whale scans reach across space and time.
works.idea_zh: 声音成为雕刻工具：海豚的咔哒声塑造图像，座头鲸的歌承载记忆，抹香鲸的声波扫描穿越空间与时间。
works.method: Hydrophone recordings from MBARI and UPC's Laboratory of Applied Bioacoustics, classified with machine learning, drive a real-time render engine; a generative-AI pipeline segments underwater footage into volumetric scenes; scientific input from Steffen De Vreese.
works.method_zh: 来自 MBARI 与加泰罗尼亚理工大学应用生物声学实验室的水听器录音经机器学习分类后，驱动实时渲染引擎；生成式 AI 流程把水下影像分割并重建为体积场景；Steffen De Vreese 提供科学支持。
shown_at: The Ocean Speaks, Disseny Hub Barcelona 2024–25
Ecos del Océano, Espacio Fundación Telefónica, Madrid 2025
Biomass, WA Museum Boola Bardip, Perth 2026
As Above, So Below, Collateral Event of La Biennale di Venezia 2026
Into the Ocean, ArtScience Museum, Singapore 2026

works.title: Poetics of Soil: Fly Agaric I
works.description: The first work in an ongoing video series on life underground, following the fly agaric mushroom and its symbiosis with trees, narrated in the words and voice of mycologist Merlin Sheldrake; Fly Agaric II and Dissolving Forest (2024) belong to the same series.
works.description_zh: 一个关于地下生命的持续影像系列中的第一件，跟随毒蝇伞及其与树木的共生，由真菌学家 Merlin Sheldrake 撰文并配音；同系列还有《Fly Agaric II》与《Dissolving Forest》（2024）。
works.idea_en: Soil is shown as a living network of fungi, bacteria and roots, inviting the viewer to consider what it is to be 'something other than human'.
works.idea_zh: 土壤被呈现为由真菌、细菌与根系组成的活网络，邀请观众思考成为“人类以外的某种存在”意味着什么。
works.method: Multichannel video and audio built from macro footage, scans and simulation of fungal growth and decomposition (details of capture not published).
works.method_zh: 多声道影像与音频，基于微距拍摄、扫描与真菌生长和分解过程的模拟（具体采集方法未公开）。
shown_at: Parallel Worlds, Gazelli Art House, Baku (COP29) 2024
SOIL: The World at Our Feet, Somerset House, London 2025
Only Trees Know, Natural History Museum, Shanghai 2026
More than Human, ArtScience Museum, Singapore 2026–27

works.title: The Beauty of Blood Flow
works.description: A short documentary on how MLF and Fraunhofer MEVIS turned medical scans of lungs, heart and blood flow into the imagery of Evolver.
works.description_zh: 一部短纪录片，讲述 MLF 与 Fraunhofer MEVIS 如何把肺、心脏与血流的医学扫描转化为《Evolver》的画面。
works.idea_en: A method film: scientific imaging is the raw material for feeling the body's interior as a landscape.
works.idea_zh: 一部方法纪录片：科学影像是把身体内部感受为风景的原材料。
works.method: Interviews and process footage of 4D-flow MRI and CT data processing by the Fraunhofer MEVIS team (Matthias Günther, Bianka Hofmann and others).
works.method_zh: 包含访谈与制作过程影像，展示 Fraunhofer MEVIS 团队（Matthias Günther、Bianka Hofmann 等）对 4D 血流 MRI 与 CT 数据的处理。

works.title: YOU:MATTER
works.description: A seven-room exhibition for Bradford 2025 UK City of Culture that traces the visitor's body back to the Big Bang: visitors breathe into a digital sequoia, watch Earth breathe CO2 from satellite data, follow a water drop from cloud to sweat, and see sunlight in their own blood vessels.
works.description_zh: 为 2025 年英国文化之城布拉德福德创作的七室展览，把观众的身体追溯到宇宙大爆炸：观众向数字红杉呼气，借卫星数据观看地球“呼吸”二氧化碳，跟随一滴水从云到汗水，并在自己的血管中看见阳光。
works.idea_en: Mostly about human belonging to cosmic and planetary cycles; the breath-into-sequoia room is the direct nonhuman encounter.
works.idea_zh: 主要关于人类如何属于宇宙与行星的循环；向红杉呼气的房间是其中直接的非人类相遇。
works.method: Breath sensors and real-time projection, NASA satellite CO2 data, head-in cloud sculptures with narration, hand-illuminating projection and face capture merged into a morphing tree of life.
works.method_zh: 呼吸传感器与实时投影、NASA 卫星二氧化碳数据、可把头伸入的云朵雕塑与旁白、照亮手部血管的投影，以及把人脸融入变形生命之树的面部捕捉。
shown_at: National Science and Media Museum, Bradford 2025–26

works.title: Breathing Planet: Atmospheric Wind Data
works.description: A 10-minute breathwork installation in a mirrored steel half-tunnel where visitors breathe in with the day and out with the night while watching a month of Earth's atmosphere (January–February 2020) swirl across a rotating globe.
works.description_zh: 一件 10 分钟的呼吸练习装置，设在镜面不锈钢半圆隧道中：观众随白昼吸气、随黑夜呼气，同时观看旋转的地球上一个月（2020 年 1 至 2 月）的大气流动。
works.idea_en: Breath is scaled up to the planet: the atmosphere is shown as co-created by all breathing beings, and the visitor breathes with it.
works.idea_zh: 把呼吸放大到行星尺度：大气被呈现为所有呼吸生命共同创造之物，观众与它一同呼吸。
works.method: NASA GEOS atmospheric reanalysis data on an 8K LED wall reflected in a mirrored tunnel, a 5-5 resonant breathing guide, and ambisonic and binaural sound by Carolyn Downing.
works.method_zh: NASA GEOS 大气再分析数据显示在 8K LED 墙上，并在镜面隧道中无限反射；配合 5-5 共振呼吸引导，以及 Carolyn Downing 的全景声与双耳声设计。

works.title: Water Body
works.description: A permanent installation in the ARTIS Aquarium, Amsterdam, that shows Earth's water as one circulating body: a year passes in ten seconds as ocean currents, swelling rivers, plankton blooms and the migrations of whales and seabirds move across the globe.
works.description_zh: 阿姆斯特丹 ARTIS 水族馆中的永久装置，把地球上的水呈现为一个循环的身体：十秒钟过去一年，洋流、涨落的河流、浮游生物爆发以及鲸和海鸟的迁徙在地球上流动。
works.idea_en: Following Robert Macfarlane, a river is treated as a living body with memory, and planetary water as an extension of our own circulation.
works.idea_zh: 借用 Robert Macfarlane 的观点，河流被视为有记忆的活的身体，而行星之水是我们自身血液循环的延伸。
works.method: Copernicus GLORYS12V1 ocean reanalysis, HydroSHEDS HydroRIVERS river networks and NASA/CNES SWOT satellite surface-water data, with animal tracking, visualised at large scale with spatial sound.
works.method_zh: 使用哥白尼 GLORYS12V1 海洋再分析数据、HydroSHEDS HydroRIVERS 河网数据、NASA/CNES SWOT 卫星地表水数据以及动物追踪数据，以大尺度影像与空间声音呈现。

works.title: The HEAL Institute, Museum of the Future
works.description: The climate-focused floor of Dubai's Museum of the Future, where visitors use a handheld 'Biosynth' device to scan, magnify and repair simulated ecosystems, from a plant nursery 'Living Wall' to rainforest regeneration around a Ceiba pentandra.
works.description_zh: 迪拜未来博物馆中以气候为主题的楼层：观众用手持“Biosynth”设备扫描、放大并修复模拟生态系统，从植物苗圃“生命之墙”到围绕吉贝木棉的雨林再生。
works.idea_en: Visitors act as ecosystem repairers rather than becoming another being; the Biosynth works as a lens into plant and soil processes.
works.idea_zh: 观众扮演生态修复者，而不是成为另一种生命；Biosynth 是观察植物与土壤过程的透镜。
works.method: Custom handheld device with object recognition and motion tracking, projection, generative visuals and multichannel audio, developed with scientists including Dr Lucy Rowland and the Royal Botanic Garden Edinburgh.
works.method_zh: 定制手持设备具备物体识别与动作追踪，结合投影、生成式影像与多声道音频，与 Lucy Rowland 博士、爱丁堡皇家植物园等科学家合作开发。

works.title: NEST
works.description: A kinetic light installation in the trees and moat of Lloyd Park, Waltham Forest, with a 15-minute multichannel soundscape by composer Erland Cooper inspired by starling murmurations.
works.description_zh: 一件设在沃尔瑟姆森林劳埃德公园树木与护城河间的动态灯光装置，配有作曲家 Erland Cooper 以椋鸟群飞为灵感创作的 15 分钟多声道声景。
works.idea_en: Light and sound move through the park like a flock, suggesting a murmuration rather than letting visitors become one.
works.idea_zh: 光与声像鸟群一样在公园中流动，暗示一场椋鸟群飞，而不是让观众成为其中一员。
works.method: Programmed moving-head lights, custom software and spatial audio mapped onto trees, water and foliage.
works.method_zh: 可编程摇头灯、定制软件与空间音频，映射到树木、水面与枝叶上。
shown_at: Waltham Forest London Borough of Culture 2019

works.title: The Quest
works.description: A kinetic light sculpture commissioned by Moët Hennessy for Hennessy Paradis Impérial, translating the blending of eaux-de-vie into choreographed light.
works.description_zh: 受 Moët Hennessy 委约、为轩尼诗百乐廷皇禧创作的动态灯光雕塑，把生命之水的调配过程转译为编排好的光。
works.idea_en: A brand commission with no nonhuman perspective; listed for completeness as a machine-choreographed object that stands in for taste.
works.idea_zh: 一件没有非人类视角的品牌委约作品；为完整起见收录，它是以机械编排的物件来替代味觉的尝试。
works.method: Motorised kinetic light sculpture with custom control software (details not published).
works.method_zh: 电动动态灯光雕塑与定制控制软件（细节未公开）。

works.title: The Ephesus Experience Museum
works.description: A projection-based museum near the ancient city of Ephesus in Türkiye, in which visitors walk through the city's history across millennia.
works.description_zh: 位于土耳其以弗所古城附近的投影式博物馆，观众在其中穿行于这座城市数千年的历史。
works.idea_en: A human-history work; listed for completeness, its nearest link to this gallery is the felt compression of deep time in stone and place.
works.idea_zh: 一件关于人类历史的作品；为完整起见收录，它与本馆最接近的联系，是让人在石头与场所中感受被压缩的深时间。
works.method: Large-scale projection, spatial audio, sculpture and animation, developed with DEM Museums, architects, historians and archaeologists.
works.method_zh: 大尺度投影、空间音频、雕塑与动画，与 DEM Museums、建筑师、历史学家和考古学家合作开发。

works.title: Patterns of Perception: Hearing
works.description: A concept film (2026) for an immersive installation opening at Oxford's Schwarzman Centre in spring 2027 that takes audiences on an 'out-of-body' journey through their own sense of hearing.
works.description_zh: 一部概念影片（2026），为 2027 年春将在牛津施瓦茨曼中心开幕的沉浸式装置而作，带领观众“离开身体”，穿行于自身的听觉之中。
works.idea_en: Human hearing is made strange by being experienced from outside, a first step toward comparing it with other species' sonic worlds.
works.idea_zh: 从外部体验人类自己的听觉，使之变得陌生，这是与其他物种声音世界进行比较的第一步。
works.method: Developed through the Oxford–Bloomberg Fellowship with Oxford humanities and medical scholars and sound artist James Bulley; installation details not yet published.
works.method_zh: 通过牛津—彭博奖学金项目，与牛津人文学科和医学学者以及声音艺术家 James Bulley 合作开发；装置细节尚未公布。

works.title: Symbiosis
works.description: A multi-user VR performance set 200 years in the future in which each visitor, wearing a custom haptic suit, inhabits a slime mould, a toad, a genetically altered orchid or a human–anglerfish hybrid, tasting and smelling their world as the characters' stories converge.
works.description_zh: 一场设定在 200 年后的多人 VR 表演：每位观众穿上定制触觉服，化身黏菌、蟾蜍、基因改造兰花或人与鮟鱇鱼的混合体，在角色故事交汇的过程中品尝、嗅闻它们的世界。
works.idea_en: Inspired by Donna Haraway's Camille Stories: becoming another species is done with the whole body, including taste, smell and skin.
works.idea_zh: 受 Donna Haraway《卡米尔故事》启发：成为另一个物种要动用整个身体，包括味觉、嗅觉与皮肤。
works.method: Individual haptic suits with soft robotics, VR audio and visuals, scent delivery and vegetarian snacks by the chefs of Karpendonkse Hoeve matched to each creature.
works.method_zh: 每人一套带软体机器人的触觉服，配合 VR 影音、气味释放，以及 Karpendonkse Hoeve 主厨为每种生物设计的素食小食。

works.title: Door Into the Dark
works.description: An immersive installation that visitors enter blindfolded, shoeless and alone, following a rope through forests, bridges and shifting rooms while binaural stories of disorientation, including from John Hull (Touching the Rock), play around them.
works.description_zh: 一件沉浸式装置：观众蒙眼、赤脚、独自进入，沿着绳索穿过森林、吊桥与变化的房间，耳边是关于迷失的双耳叙事，其中包括《Touching the Rock》作者 John Hull 的讲述。
works.idea_en: Taking sight away makes feet, hands and ears lead, a human route into touch-first worlds without a headset.
works.idea_zh: 拿走视觉，让脚、手和耳朵引路，这是一条不借助头显、通往触觉优先世界的人类路径。
works.method: Rope-guided physical set with varied floor textures, sensors that trigger binaural audio as participants progress, and documentary interviews.
works.method_zh: 以绳索引导的实体场景，地面材质多变，传感器随参与者前进触发双耳音频，内容来自纪录访谈。

works.title: Franchise Freedom
works.description: A night-time performance in which hundreds of lit drones fly as an autonomous swarm following an algorithm derived from starling murmurations, first over Art Basel Miami Beach.
works.description_zh: 一场夜间表演：数百架发光无人机按照源自椋鸟群飞的算法自主成群飞行，首演于迈阿密海滩巴塞尔艺术展上空。
works.idea_en: Machines borrow a bird flock's rules, so the audience perceives flocking behaviour, not individual birds, as the being on stage.
works.idea_zh: 机器借用鸟群的规则，于是观众感知到的舞台主角是“群飞”这一行为本身，而不是某一只鸟。
works.method: Software modelling starling flight behaviour, from research begun in 2007 with Flylight, embedded in Intel Shooting Star drones.
works.method_zh: 模拟椋鸟飞行行为的软件（研究始于 2007 年的作品《Flylight》），植入英特尔 Shooting Star 无人机。

works.title: Meandering River
works.description: A multi-screen audiovisual installation that shows, from a bird's-eye view, rivers carving and shifting across a landscape over time, with music composed by an AI.
works.description_zh: 一件多屏视听装置，以鸟瞰视角呈现河流随时间在大地上冲刷、改道的过程，配有 AI 作曲的音乐。
works.idea_en: River change, normally too slow to see, is sped up so its rhythm can be felt, a way of taking up a river's timescale.
works.idea_zh: 把平时慢到看不见的河流变迁加速，让它的节奏可以被感受到，这是进入河流时间尺度的一种方式。
works.method: Real-time visuals generated by a bespoke erosion algorithm across multiple screens, with a soundtrack composed by a machine-learning model.
works.method_zh: 由定制侵蚀算法实时生成、跨多块屏幕的影像，配以机器学习模型创作的配乐。
shown_at: AI for Good Global Summit, UN Geneva 2019

leads.name: Jakob Kudsk Steensen — The Deep Listener, RE-ANIMATED, Berl-Berl
leads.why: Berlin-based Danish artist; AR/VR works that let you hear Hyde Park species or revisit the extinct Kauaʻi ʻōʻō; site was unreachable during this batch.

leads.name: Somniacs — Birdly
leads.why: Swiss full-body flight simulator (2014) in which you fly as a red kite by flapping your arms; already in the games batch.

leads.name: Wolfgang Buttress — The Hive
leads.why: UK Pavilion, Milan Expo 2015, then Kew: light and sound driven live by vibrations inside a real beehive.

leads.name: Universal Everything — Future You
leads.why: Mirror installation where an evolving machine avatar learns your movements; possible robot-body entry.

leads.name: Alchemy Immersive — Micro Monsters with David Attenborough
leads.why: UK VR series (2020) at insect scale; mostly shows rather than embodies, borderline.

leads.name: Superflux — Refuge for Resurgence / Invocation for Hope
leads.why: UK speculative multispecies installations (collaborators on MLF's HEAL Institute); no embodiment, but a strong more-than-human counterpoint.

leads.name: Ferryman Collective
leads.why: Live social-VR theatre (Gumball Dreams, Tearless); no nonhuman embodiment found.

leads.name: Presstube / Dpt. — A Colossal Wave co-creators
leads.why: Montreal collaborators on MLF's A Colossal Wave.

leads.name: Mileece I'Anson
leads.why: Sound artist who sonified plant biosignals for Treehugger; own plant-sonification works may fit Becoming Tree.

leads.name: MLF — MEMEX | Duologue (2014)
leads.why: Photogrammetry music-video study of a scanned human body; human-centred, not researched further.

leads.name: MLF — U2 'Invisible' (2014)
leads.why: Real-time visual system for a Mark Romanek music video; commercial.

leads.name: MLF — The Measures Taken (2014)
leads.why: Interactive light for Alexander Whitley's dance piece at the Royal Opera House; human bodies only.

leads.name: MLF — early commercial work (McLaren P1, Vodafone Evolution of Mobile, Sony PS3 projection mapping, Intel, Famous Grouse kinetic sculpture, Saatchi NDS 2011, Just for Hits with Richard Dawkins, Liquid Light for Johnnie Walker, Ron Arad's Curtain Call)
leads.why: Brand and event commissions 2011–2023 listed on the MLF Vimeo channel and old site; no nonhuman perspective.
